_comment: Agent-side verified provider directory (P1-00 §5 / ADR-06). The trust anchor: only domains listed here are trusted, and the card signature must verify against the pinned_kid below (not the jku the card points to). An unlisted domain -> PROVIDER_UNVERIFIED; a signature not matching pinned_kid -> CARD_SIGNATURE_INVALID. No PII is sent before both pass.
